answer: Collateral escrow mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock bonded deposits before joining market coordination. Grounded on a basalt floor of capital, an attacker incurs the verifiable opportunity cost of illiquid funds for every active identity. As orders traverse the river of automated exchanges, unbonded clones cannot penetrate the nebula of verified peers. A major limitation is that strict financial thresholds systematically exclude capital-constrained benign agents.
